line.a_ksiazka.text: Bunny, I have a new picture book. I'll read it to you!

line.a_szybko.text: Give it, give it, quick, I want to see!

line.a_ojej.text: Oh no! The pages fell out. I'll put them back right now!

line.a_czyta_zle.text: Let's read. First there was the hen, then the egg, and last a chick hatched out of the egg... Something is odd here.

line.a_smieszne.text: Hee hee, something's wrong here. Where did the hen come from, before there was a chick?

line.a_po_kolei.text: Because the pages are mixed up. A story happens in order: first, then, and last.

line.a_uloz.text: Help us put the pages in order. What came first? Start at the arrow.

line.zla_kolejnosc.text: That's not its place. What happens earlier, and what later?

line.zla_kolejnosc.lisek.text: That's not its place. What happens earlier, and what later?

line.zla_kolejnosc.zajac.text: That's not its place. What happens earlier, and what later?

line.a_czyta_dobrze.text: First there was an egg, then a chick hatched out of the egg, and last the chick grew up into a hen.

line.a_ma_sens.text: Now it makes sense! Egg, chick, hen.

line.b_nasiono.text: Hello! In the garden everything happens in order too. Look, I'm planting a seed.

line.b_najpierw.text: First a seed in the soil.

line.b_na_koncu.text: And last a flower! A tulip.

line.b_uloz.text: I drew it in pictures, but they got mixed up. Put them in order, start at the arrow.

line.b_dobrze.text: Yes! First the seed, then the sprout, and last the flower.

line.b_balwan.text: I also drew a story about a snowman, but I lost one page from the middle.

line.b_ktora.text: First one snowball, last a finished snowman. Point to what came in between.

line.b_ktora_nie.text: That page is from another story. We're looking for the snowman.

line.b_balwan_ok.text: Yes! Two snowballs, and only then the hat and the scarf. The story is whole.

line.p_start.text: Let's play with stories! I have a few games for you.

line.p_ciasto.text: How do you bake a cake? Put the pictures in order.

line.p_co_pierwsze.text: In our book, what came first: the hen or the egg?

line.p_co_pierwsze_nie.text: In our story the egg came first.

line.p_jajko.text: The egg! And out of the egg a chick.

line.p_ostatnie.text: Point to what comes last in this story.

line.p_ostatnie_nie.text: That comes earlier. What grows at the very end?

line.p_kwiat.text: The flower! The flower comes last.

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards and find the pairs.

line.d_kanapka.text: I'll make the sandwiches! Quick, everything at once!

line.d_uloz.text: Put on the counter how a sandwich is made. Start at the arrow.

line.d_mniam.text: Bread, butter and cheese. Yum, yum, a tasty sandwich!

line.d_rodzice.text: Tell your parents a story in three pictures: what came first, what next, and what last.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping with my book! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the chick that hatched in the henhouse behind Fox's garden. We got it when we put stories in order.

line.a_dowolnie.text: Hen, egg, chick. Done! The order doesn't matter.

line.a_naprawde.text: But is it true that a chick comes out of an egg? I want to see it with my own eyes!

line.a_do_liska.text: Let's go to Fox. Behind his garden there is a henhouse, and a hen lives in it.

line.b_miny.text: The snowman has a funny face. And I can make all kinds of faces! Shall we play mirror?

line.b_kurnik.text: Can you hear it? Cluck, cluck, cluck! The hen is calling us from the henhouse. Let's hurry!

line.c_kurnik.text: What a pretty red little house, with straw in front of it. Does the hen live here?

line.c_gniazdo.text: Yes. Look, her egg is lying in the nest.

line.c_rusza.text: The egg is moving! Something is about to happen.

line.c_co_potem.text: First there is the egg. Point to what comes next.

line.c_co_potem_nie.text: The hen comes last, when the chick has grown up. What comes out of the egg?

line.c_piskle.text: A chick! It hatched out of the egg, and the hen is cuddling it.

line.c_kura.text: And when the chick grows up, it will be a big hen. First the egg, then the chick, and last the hen.

line.c_juz_wiem.text: Now I know! Everything happens in order, just like in Owl's book.

line.c_do_domu.text: So now, in order: first we go home, then we have a snack, and last I'll read you the whole book.

line.p_ciasto_ok.text: Yes! First flour and eggs, then we stir, and last there is the cake.

line.p_balwan_ok.text: Yes! First one snowball, then two, and last the snowman in his hat.

line.d_dom.text: We're home. In order: first a snack, and then the book.

line.d_zajac_robi.text: Cheese, butter, bread. The order doesn't matter!

line.d_ojej.text: Oh no! The bread slid onto the floor, and the butter is on the cheese.

line.d_najpierw.text: We make a sandwich in order too. First bread, then butter, and last cheese.

line.d_co_najpierw.text: Point to what goes on the plate first.

line.d_co_najpierw_nie.text: That goes on later. What is at the very bottom of a sandwich?

line.d_chleb.text: Bread! First a slice of bread.

line.d_talerz.text: We've eaten. Now put the plate away on the shelf, and then we read.

line.d_czytanie.text: And now the book I promised. I'm reading it to you page by page, in order.

line.d_czytanie_zajac.text: It's so good that the pages are in the right order!

line.d_opowiem.text: And I'll tell a story about today. Point to the pictures in order: what came first, what next, and what last.

line.d_dzien_nie.text: That was later. What did we do before?

line.d_dzien_1.text: First Owl showed me her book, and the pages fell out.

line.d_dzien_2.text: Then at Fox's a flower grew from a seed.

line.d_dzien_3.text: And last a chick hatched out of an egg!

line.p_memory_ok.text: All the pairs found: the egg, the chick, the hen and the sprout!

line.d_talerz_ok.text: The plate is on the shelf, all tidy. And now the book!
